title: Google Chat alerts and slow-query watcher (bridge, watcher, rules, fake Chat receiver)
proves: Unit tests for sanitizer, router, formatter, dedup, rate limit; promtool check/test of slow-query.rules.yml; amtool check of alertmanager.gchat.yml; compose config; least-privilege read-only role; live: pg_sleep(7) produces a Slow Queries post with no literals, critical/warning/resolved/Watchdog routing, 5xx/429 retry, permanent failure does not crash, secrets absent from logs and /metrics (full adds burst rate limit and digest).
doesNotProve: Delivery to real Google Chat, the production Postgres or its pg_stat_statements, memory under production load, Grafana contact points and the deploy notifier (built on another branch).
